name: slow_ceremony
description: Six exposures eight seconds apart, of the same two people at the same altar under the same light.
why: The hard direction. Every frame looks like every other frame, so appearance says one moment and only the cadence says otherwise. A photographer grouping these would call them six separate attempts, because eight seconds is long enough for the vows to have moved on. A grouper that returned one moment here would lose five photographs and never say so.
labelled_by: PHASE-08 section 8 step 9, authored ground truth
